verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail says it has an API, but no machine-readable spec can be downloaded. Probes of the standard OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404, and api.virtualpostmail.com/swagger returns 401. The help center says developer information is available only by contacting the company, and no public spec or reference exists.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
